steps.content: Coquelic's path is strewn with debris, a trail of deep red marking her journey.
Her floral sword shatters in her hand, she discards it casually, her head hung low as she chuckles under her breath.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I've been stripped away more than once. After all, there are too many assholes in this world.
The last two HUSH elites see her empty hands and seize the opportunity to attack.
They are pierced, shattered, and fall just before they can reach her.
Coquelic steps over them and continues forward, taking one step after another towards Shalom.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The first time, someone kicked my cat. He was several years older than me, a deadbeat. I beat him for a long, long time, leaving scars on his hands and face that never faded.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The second time, someone took my family away. I stormed into his mansion alone and wiped out all the arrogant scum in my path. In the end, that lord kneeled before me, sobbing and repenting for four hours until his voice was hoarse, then I finished him off.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The third time, someone took my friend's eyes. I locked him in a pitch-black basement. Within a mere two months, he ended his own life... Heh, that was not even close to a lifetime.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The fourth time, the fifth time, the sixth time... I've lost count of how many times it's been for me.
She raises her hand, and the fallen soldiers under her feet convulse as a bright red bud is drawn from within them, quickly solidifying into a sword. Coquelic picks it up and swings.
The dense blue light that shoots out shatters upon collision with the crystallized thorns. She advances through the dancing shards; nothing can stop her relentless steps.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Many people who ask me for revenge are in great pain. They've only experienced it once, only been knocked down once. They vividly remember the pain but feel helpless, thinking they can never move on.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh, that's not the case... They'll understand once they've been through it a few more times. There's nothing you can't defeat, as long as you're determined to bring it down, sparing nothing.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, let them see the price, so we all understand—nobody can touch what belongs to Coquelic.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What's taken away from me, I must take back, even if it turns into ruins, it must return to me. After that...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: People are resilient, they prosper above the ruins. New sprouts will emerge from broken places, new branches will grow from scorched grounds.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: All those who offend me will meet the same end. Then, I am reborn time and time again. Just like this...

She swings her sword to meet the incoming Schorl laser. The blue light rapidly purifies the Mania longsword in her hand. The bright red crystal falls to the ground, shattering into countless dust particles.
Coquelic shows no regret. She places her hand over her left chest, presses, and pulls.

In an instant, a vivid red power gushes from her chest, eagerly blooming outward, gathering in her palm. It's a bright red longsword made by an S-Class sinner, using her soul and life. Coquelic casually swings it, cutting through the blue beam.

Schorl issues a more piercing warning, the signal shoots straight to Paradeisos. Immediately, a shower of blue light descends from the sky, piercing the entire building roof and charging at Coquelic. She lifts her sword and dances in the air, blocking the light rain like an umbrella, then she disappears.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Do you think you can easily toy with people's lives? Do you think you can easily defeat me?
She had already appeared right in front of Shalom, the tip of her sword leaving a bloody mark on the ground.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I wouldn't dare, Mentor. I know your time is much longer than mine.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You know better than me what is destined.

Schorl makes a judgment. The opposing Sinner cannot be stopped. It immediately turns to target Shalom, but it's too slow. The red light instantly shatters Schorl, then pierces straight through Shalom's chest, deeply pushing in, and then...
Coquelic pulls back, actually pulling flowers out of Shalom's chest.

Flowers continuously bloom from Shalom's chest. The little color that was on her face quickly drains away, her soul and life transform into Mania, being forcibly extracted by the furious Mentor, burning in her palm.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I guess you wouldn't die like this, monster of Paradeisos. So, bloom... Let me see what kind of flowers such an arrogant, inhuman devil can bloom, to see how ugly your life is.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So that I can design a revenge play for you and vent my anger!

Shalom doesn't do anything, she just watches the Schorl in the air turn to ashes, watches the crystallized flowers gushing from her chest, watches all the barriers set by Paradeisos get completely destroyed.
And the one who defeated the invincible is the Sinner before her, one who scorches everything in her path and blooms in the darkness, if only for a fleeting moment.
Shalom finally shows a satisfied smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is the power you traded your life for, sacrificing all flowing futures for absolute strength and freedom.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Only a Sinner would make this choice, only you could push to this point. It's truly splendid.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Thank you for being so strong and unyielding... I knew you could win.
At the end of the destruction, a cold triangular symbol flashes in the eyes of the Hush.
Before Coquelic can react, the flowers she pulled out exudes a strange, terrifying aura. She feels something gathering behind her, a gigantic figure, a true <color=#fb9259>monster</color>.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're not blooming a flower, you're...
In the next moment, her consciousness is swallowed whole by the colossal entity.
